name: Fell Runner Imogen

intro.text: The Lyke Wake Walk: forty miles across the moor in a single day. Only the brave, the foolish and the very well-organised.

win: That's a proper pace. I yield, and I stagger.
after: They call it 'the Lyke Wake' after an old funeral dirge. A walk across the whole moor in a day. Take a flask.
